name: choose a step length by sufficient decrease
mechanism: given a descent direction, try a step and shrink it until the objective decreases by at least a fraction of what the gradient predicts, so each step is neither too long to diverge nor accepted blindly

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Line search' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms:

fails_when: many objective evaluations per step on badly scaled problems
